title: Artiva Biotherapeutics Appoints Veteran Biotech Executive and Drug Developer Diego Miralles, M.D., as President and Head of Research and Development
author: Na
description: Artiva Biotherapeutics announced the appointment of Diego Miralles, M.D., as President and Head of Research and Development. Miralles brings over 20 years of biotech leadership experience and previously served on Artiva's Board. The appointment comes as Artiva prepares for Phase 3 registrational trials of its lead program AlloNK in refractory rheumatoid arthritis, with plans to file a BLA in 2029.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The appointment of an experienced executive with a proven track record of advancing therapies to FDA approval and commercialization strengthens leadership during a critical phase of development. Recent FDA alignment on registrational pathway and plans for Phase 3 trials in refractory RA demonstrate clinical progress and de-risking of the program.

title: Rheumatoid Arthritis Clinical Trial Pipeline: DelveInsight Highlights Major Advances, Transformative Therapies, and 75+ Leading Players Wheeling the Therapeutics Landscape
author: Delveinsight
description: DelveInsight's 2026 report reveals a robust rheumatoid arthritis pipeline with 75+ active players developing 80+ drugs across various clinical stages. The report highlights emerging therapies targeting novel pathways beyond traditional TNF inhibition, including JAK inhibitors, BTK inhibitors, and cell-based immunotherapies. Recent developments include positive Phase III results for Lynk Pharmaceuticals' zemprocitinib, FDA Fast Track designation for Artiva Biotherapeutics' AlloNK, and multiple licensing agreements signaling significant innovation in the RA treatment landscape.

title: Artiva Biotherapeutics to Participate in the 25th Annual Needham Virtual Healthcare Conference
author: Not Specified
description: Artiva Biotherapeutics announced that its management will participate in a panel and fireside chat at the 25th Annual Needham Virtual Healthcare Conference on April 15, 2026. The clinical-stage biotech company is developing cell therapies for autoimmune diseases and cancers, with its lead program AlloNK currently in three ongoing clinical trials for B-cell driven autoimmune diseases.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company is actively advancing its clinical pipeline with multiple ongoing trials for AlloNK in autoimmune diseases and expanding into CAR-NK candidates for cancers. Management participation in major healthcare conferences demonstrates investor engagement and confidence in the company's progress and pipeline development.

title: Artiva Biotherapeutics Announces Appointment of Thad Huston as Chief Financial Officer and Award of Inducement Grant
author: Artiva Biotherapeutics, Inc.
description: Artiva Biotherapeutics appointed Thad Huston as Chief Financial Officer, bringing over 30 years of global leadership experience in pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and medical devices. Huston received an inducement grant of 220,000 restricted stock units vesting over four years. The appointment comes as Artiva prepares to receive FDA feedback on its lead program AlloNK and share clinical efficacy data in rheumatoid arthritis in the first half of 2026.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The appointment of an experienced CFO with strong track record in late-stage development and commercialization signals organizational strengthening and preparation for key clinical milestones. The company is advancing toward FDA feedback and clinical data readouts, indicating progress in its pipeline development.

title: Artiva Biotherapeutics Reports Third Quarter 2025 Financial Results and Recent Business Highlights
author: Artiva Biotherapeutics
description: Artiva Biotherapeutics reported treating over 100 patients with AlloNK across autoimmune and oncology indications, receiving FDA Fast Track Designation for refractory rheumatoid arthritis treatment. The company expects initial clinical response data in first half of 2026 and has $123 million cash runway into Q2 2027.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company achieved significant clinical milestones, received FDA Fast Track Designation, treated over 100 patients, and maintains strong cash position through Q2 2027
